detail.name: Komano Manato's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Komano Manato's Mindscape: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
detail.desc2:
A card printed with an image of Sailume Bay's unofficial mediator.
This business card can smooth over a number of minor issues, but its use is limited to certain areas of Waifei Peninsula. During Manato's make-up exams, the card functions merely as a simple referral.
A sketch of a "grand and imposing" canine Thiren was drawn on the back, though in crayon, making it feel a little less threatening.
